```{sql, connection = con}
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS data;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS data.bixi_stations;
CREATE TABLE data.bixi_stations (
    station_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    external_id    TEXT,
    name           TEXT,
    short_name     TEXT,
    capacity       INTEGER,
    rental_methods TEXT[],
    is_charging    BOOLEAN,
    has_kiosk      BOOLEAN,
    geom           GEOMETRY(Point, 4326)
);

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_bixi;
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_bixi (data jsonb);
```

```{r}
bixi_raw <- readr::read_file("https://gbfs.velobixi.com/gbfs/fr/station_information.json")
DBI::dbExecute(con, "INSERT INTO tmp_bixi VALUES (?)", list(bixi_raw))
```

```{sql, connection = con}
INSERT INTO data.bixi_stations
SELECT
    elem->>'station_id',
    elem->>'external_id',
    elem->>'name',
    elem->>'short_name',
    (elem->>'capacity')::int,
    ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(elem->'rental_methods')),
    (elem->>'is_charging')::boolean,
    (elem->>'has_kiosk')::boolean,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint((elem->>'lon')::float, (elem->>'lat')::float), 4326)
FROM tmp_bixi, jsonb_array_elements(data->'data'->'stations') AS elem
ON CONFLICT (station_id) DO NOTHING;
```

```{sql, connection = con}
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgrouting;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS analyse_pgrouting;
SET search_path = analyse_pgrouting, data, public;
```

```{sql, connection = con}
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS analyse_pgrouting.reseau;
CREATE TABLE analyse_pgrouting.reseau AS
SELECT id_trc::BIGINT, (ST_Dump(geom)).geom AS geom
FROM data.reseau_routier;
```

```{sql, connection = con}
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau;
CREATE TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau AS
WITH
points_intersection AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ST_Intersection(a.geom, b.geom) AS geom
    FROM analyse_pgrouting.reseau a
    JOIN analyse_pgrouting.reseau b ON a.id_trc < b.id_trc
    WHERE ST_Intersects(a.geom, b.geom)
      AND GeometryType(ST_Intersection(a.geom, b.geom)) = 'POINT'
),
decoupage_ligne AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_Split(r.geom, pts.geom))).geom AS geom
    FROM analyse_pgrouting.reseau AS r
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT ST_Union(geom) AS geom FROM points_intersection) AS pts
)
SELECT DISTINCT geom
FROM decoupage_ligne
WHERE GeometryType(geom) = 'LINESTRING';
```

```{sql, connection = con}
DROP SEQUENCE IF EXISTS analyse_pgrouting.street_seq;
CREATE SEQUENCE analyse_pgrouting.street_seq START 1;
ALTER TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS id_trc BIGINT;
UPDATE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau SET id_trc = nextval('analyse_pgrouting.street_seq');
```

```{sql, connection = con}
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_geom_newreseau ON analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau USING GIST (geom);
```

```{sql, connection = con}
ALTER TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS source;
ALTER TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau ADD COLUMN "source" BIGINT;
ALTER TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS target;
ALTER TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau ADD COLUMN "target" BIGINT;
ALTER TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS cost;
ALTER TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau ADD COLUMN cost REAL;
UPDATE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau SET cost = ST_Length(geom::geography);
```

```{sql, connection = con}
ALTER TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS cost_pondere;
ALTER TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau ADD COLUMN cost_pondere REAL;

UPDATE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau SET cost_pondere = cost * 1.0;

UPDATE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau r
SET cost_pondere = cost * facteur
FROM (
    SELECT r2.id_trc,
        MIN(CASE c.type_voie
            WHEN 'Piste cyclable en site propre'        THEN 0.3
            WHEN 'Piste cyclable sur rue'               THEN 0.4
            WHEN 'Piste cyclable au niveau du trottoir' THEN 0.4
            WHEN 'Vélorue'                              THEN 0.5
            WHEN 'Bande cyclable'                       THEN 0.6
            WHEN 'Sentier polyvalent'                   THEN 0.7
            WHEN 'Voie partagée Bus-Vélo'               THEN 0.8
            WHEN 'Chaussée désignée'                    THEN 0.9
            ELSE 1.0
        END) AS facteur
    FROM analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau r2
    JOIN data.pistes_cyclables c ON ST_DWithin(r2.geom, c.geom, 0.0001)
    GROUP BY r2.id_trc
) sub
WHERE r.id_trc = sub.id_trc;
```

```{sql, connection = con}
ALTER TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS reverse_cost;
ALTER TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau ADD COLUMN reverse_cost REAL;

-- Étape 1 : initialisation bidirectionnelle
UPDATE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau
SET reverse_cost = cost_pondere;

-- Étape 2 : jointure par le tronçon original le plus proche du centroïde
-- ON PREND UN SEUL tronçon original par tronçon découpé
UPDATE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau r
SET
    cost_pondere = CASE
        WHEN rr.sens_cir = -1 THEN 1e9
        ELSE r.cost_pondere
    END,
    reverse_cost = CASE
        WHEN rr.sens_cir = 0  THEN r.cost_pondere
        WHEN rr.sens_cir = 1  THEN 1e9
        WHEN rr.sens_cir = -1 THEN r.cost_pondere
        ELSE r.cost_pondere
    END
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (r2.id_trc)
        r2.id_trc,
        rr2.sens_cir
    FROM analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau r2
    JOIN data.reseau_routier rr2
        ON ST_DWithin(ST_Centroid(r2.geom), rr2.geom, 0.001)
    ORDER BY r2.id_trc, ST_Distance(ST_Centroid(r2.geom), rr2.geom)
) AS rr
WHERE r.id_trc = rr.id_trc;
```

```{sql, connection = con}
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau_vertices;
SELECT * INTO analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau_vertices
FROM pgr_extractVertices('SELECT id_trc AS id, geom FROM analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau');
```

```{sql, connection = con}
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_geom_newreseau_vertices ON analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau_vertices USING GIST (geom);
```

```{sql, connection = con}
UPDATE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau AS r
SET source = v.id
FROM analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau_vertices AS v
WHERE ST_DWithin(ST_StartPoint(r.geom), v.geom, 0.000001);
```

```{sql, connection = con}
UPDATE analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau AS r
SET target = v.id
FROM analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau_vertices AS v
WHERE ST_DWithin(ST_EndPoint(r.geom), v.geom, 0.000001);
```

```{r}
adresse_depart  <- "3029 Boulevard Édouard Montpetit, Montréal, Québec, H3T 1S1, Canada"
adresse_arrivee <- "1375 Avenue Thérèse-Lavoie-Roux, Montréal, Québec, H2V 0B3, Canada"
```

```{r}
coord_depart <- tidygeocoder::geo(address = adresse_depart, method = "osm", verbose = TRUE, full_results = TRUE)
depart_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(coord_depart, coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  select(osm_id, address, geometry) %>%
  rename(geog = geometry)

coord_arrivee <- geo(address = adresse_arrivee, method = "osm", verbose = TRUE, full_results = TRUE)
arrivee_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(coord_arrivee, coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  select(osm_id, address, geometry) %>%
  rename(geog = geometry)
```

```{sql, connection = con}
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS analyse_pgrouting.pt_depart_bixi;
CREATE TABLE analyse_pgrouting.pt_depart_bixi (
    id         BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    osm_id     BIGINT,
    station_id TEXT,
    name       TEXT,
    distance   DOUBLE PRECISION,
    geom       GEOMETRY(Point, 4326)
);
```

```{sql, connection = con}
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS analyse_pgrouting.pt_depart_reseau;
CREATE TABLE analyse_pgrouting.pt_depart_reseau (
    id       BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    osm_id   BIGINT,
    id_noeud BIGINT,
    distance DOUBLE PRECISION
);
```

```{sql, connection = con}
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fct_depart_bixi()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO analyse_pgrouting.pt_depart_bixi (
        osm_id, station_id, name, distance, geom
    )
    SELECT
        NEW.osm_id,
        b.station_id,
        b.name,
        ST_Distance(NEW.geog, b.geom::geography),
        b.geom
    FROM data.bixi_stations b
    ORDER BY NEW.geog <-> b.geom::geography
    LIMIT 1;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
```

```{sql, connection = con}
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_fct_depart_bixi ON analyse_pgrouting.pt_depart;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_fct_depart_bixi
AFTER INSERT ON analyse_pgrouting.pt_depart
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION fct_depart_bixi();
```

```{sql, connection = con}
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fct_depart_node_network()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO analyse_pgrouting.pt_depart_reseau (
        osm_id, id_noeud, distance
    )
    SELECT
        NEW.osm_id,
        n.id,
        ST_Distance(NEW.geom::geography, n.geom::geography)
    FROM analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau_vertices n
    ORDER BY NEW.geom::geography <-> n.geom::geography
    LIMIT 1;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
```

```{sql, connection = con}
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_fct_depart_node_network ON analyse_pgrouting.pt_depart_bixi;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_fct_depart_node_network
AFTER INSERT ON analyse_pgrouting.pt_depart_bixi
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION fct_depart_node_network();
```

```{sql, connection = con}
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS analyse_pgrouting.new_shpath2;
CREATE TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_shpath2 AS
SELECT *
FROM pgr_dijkstra(
    'SELECT id_trc AS id, source::INT4, target::INT4,
            cost_pondere AS cost,
            reverse_cost          -- ← NOUVEAU : sens de circulation
     FROM analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau
     WHERE source IS NOT NULL AND target IS NOT NULL'::text,
    (SELECT id_noeud FROM analyse_pgrouting.pt_depart_reseau ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT id_noeud FROM analyse_pgrouting.pt_arrivee_reseau ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),
    true  -- ← NOUVEAU : dirigé
);
```

```{sql, connection = con}
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS analyse_pgrouting.new_shpath2_geom;
CREATE TABLE analyse_pgrouting.new_shpath2_geom AS
SELECT
    sp.seq,
    sp.node,
    sp.edge,
    sp.cost,
    r.id_trc,
    r.geom,
    r.cost          AS cost_reel_m,
    r.cost_pondere  AS cost_pondere_m,
    r.source,
    r.target
FROM analyse_pgrouting.new_shpath2 AS sp
LEFT JOIN analyse_pgrouting.new_reseau AS r ON sp.edge = r.id_trc;
```

```{r}
new_shpath2_sf <- st_read(con, query = "SELECT * FROM analyse_pgrouting.new_shpath2_geom")

plot(new_shpath2_sf$geom)
mapview(new_shpath2_sf)
```
